item.title: French Senate approves police shootings law dubbed ‘licence to kill’ by critics
item.description: French senators gave final approval on Friday to a law presuming that police officers who use their weapons are acting lawfully, a proposal ‌that left-wing parliamentarians oppose and seek to challenge at the Constitutional Council. A long-standing demand of far-right politicians, the law gives an officer who killed someone by shooting the benefit of the doubt, unless there is proof to the contrary. Critics have dubbed it “a licence to kill”. Senators backed the law by 205 votes to 110 in the...

item.title: Man, 61, arrested over fake Chanel, Dior perfumes sold in alleged scam run by his son
item.description: A 61-year-old Hong Kong man has been arrested on suspicion of selling fake luxury perfume in an online scam operation that made more than HK$6 million (US$765,500) in illicit profits since 2023. Customs officials, who also accused the man of money laundering, said the suspect had operated the Hong Kong side of the business for his 30-year-old son, who is alleged to have masterminded the scam operation from overseas. item.title: UN talks pledge to draft ‘killer robot’ rules by 2028 after Russian pushback
item.description: UN talks on regulating weapons with little or no human oversight ended on Saturday with a pledge ‌for further discussions to develop new rules within two years, an outcome weakened by Russia’s opposition and disappointing human rights groups. Proponents had called for legally binding rules within a short time frame to regulate weapons systems that can identify and engage targets with varying degrees of autonomy, sometimes called “killer robots”. item.title: Using IDs to check concert tickets, combat scalping could slow entry: tourism chief
item.description: Hong Kong’s tourism chief has warned that requiring fans to show identity cards that match the names on their concert tickets to combat scalping could slow entry at venues, saying arrangements would need to be discussed with organisers for each event.
